visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a beige button-down shirt over a white t-shirt, stands behind a wooden table. He holds a small bag of snacks and gestures towards the camera while speaking. The background is a plain, dimly lit gray wall. (2) The camera zooms in slightly as he holds up a white and yellow box labeled 'POW-R1 HIGH ENERGY BAR'. He points to the box with his right hand while maintaining eye contact with the lens. (3) He places the box down and picks up a green, vacuum-sealed military ration pack. He uses both hands to tear open the plastic packaging, focusing intently on the task. (4) He takes out a rectangular, compressed light-brown bar from the green pack. He brings it to his nose to smell it, then breaks a piece off and puts it into his mouth. He chews and smiles, nodding his head. (5) He holds a red and white bag of Taiwanese snacks in one hand and the compressed bar in the other, comparing them visually for the camera. (6) He gestures energetically with both hands, pointing off-camera as if talking to a staff member about organizing a group purchase. (7) He walks partially out of the frame and then returns, holding the snack bag and pointing directly at the camera with an excited expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice begins speaking in an energetic, rapid-fire tone, promoting a group purchase. High-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat is heard. (2) The speaker transitions to discussing survival bags and combat rations, with his pitch fluctuating as he emphasizes specific words. (3) A distinct plastic rustling sound occurs as packaging is opened. The BGM remains constant, providing a driving energy. (4) The speaker's voice lowers slightly as he describes the calorie content and shelf life of the bars, followed by a sharp 'whoosh' transition sound. (5) Audible crunching and chewing sounds are captured as the speaker tastes the food, accompanied by appreciative vocalizations. (6) The vocal intensity increases again towards the end as he urges the audience to check the link, with the BGM swelling slightly before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote specific high-energy survival food rations by conducting a taste test comparison between international and local products. It uses an enthusiastic, energetic presentation style to engage viewers and direct them toward a group-buying link provided in the description.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The presenter actively encourages viewers to check a group-buy link and demonstrates the products' value through a taste test and shelf-life comparison.
